payload.friendly_name: Mission Status Read API: overview from the ledger and events
payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Mission Status Read API: overview from the ledger and events on issue-5529-mission-status-read-api-overview so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Mission Status Read API: overview from the ledger and events

payload.wp_title: Phase 0: campsite-clean the contract-tools filter-group test
Phase 1b: Gradle scaffold, supply chain and skeleton service
Phase 1c: path-filtered workflow, four native hello-route legs, gate helper
Phase 2a-1: domain core (reducer, derivations, cursors, paging, projection) and ledger codec
Phase 2a-2: application layer, ports, change feed, in-memory source, ArchUnit, port-level suite
Phase 2b: Python oracle, fixtures, goldens, golden-honesty test and CI routing
Phase 3a: filesystem outbound adapter (resolver, containment, allowlist, listing, faults)
Phase 3b: golden suite on the real adapter, second leg of the port-level subset, FR-013 floor
Phase 4a: HTTP routes, SSE, contract document, wiring, bind guard, contract validation
Phase 4b: Host and Origin filter (403 set, container 400 set, E-7 provisional rows)
Phase 5b: performance ratio tests (NFR-001, NFR-002, NFR-004)
Phase 5c: nightly full-corpus comparison job and script
Phase 5d: tag-triggered release job (operator decision E-4)
Phase 5e: Host/Origin smoke stage, README, docs and changelog close-out
Phase 5a: native smoke replay (stage base), per-leg digests, gate digest comparison
Phase 1a: spike and decision record (R-2, R-7 items, each with a fallback)
Phase 2a-2: projection component and ledger line codec
Phase 2a-4: ArchUnit rule set, port-level conformance suite, interim id check and 2a exit gate
Phase 3a-2: FilesystemMissionEventSource, flow-level allowlist checks and README stub
Phase 4a-2: SSE events controller, cross-route flow checks and real native-tagged tests
